name: 40299 · Louisville, KY
findings: ZIP 40299 (Louisville) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 68 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40299 (Louisville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 40299 (Louisville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
